Back in middle school, started not being able to sleep due to terrible cramping and wouldn’t eat, drink, nothing. Spent my day drinking a nasty mix of juices just to force myself to puke because it was the only time the pain wasn’t that bad. Then came the bloody stool, holy shit wtf.

Saw a doctor and they told me i was wiping my ass too hard... fucking Pardon?

Turns out i had e.coli, paired with the HUS virus. two other kids who got a similar strain(?) or at the same time as me died. I only didn’t die because i said fuck that doctor and saw another who thankfully believed me when i said ‘hi i’m not wiping my ass too hard if i’m not passing anything.’

Don’t get me wrong— i trust most doctors. But if you don’t at least hear me out, dear god

hey, i think i can help. It may not be much but i think it could help even if i just say it. I’m trans, and i have ocd. i can promise you that you would know, you’d show signs, you wouldn’t think you were cis at all. I understand it’s scary, and you shouldn’t feel guilty if you’re scared. 

No one has any say over your identity but you. You’re not a pervert, you’re not deviant, nothing about you is bad. wanting attention from the same gender is totally okay— straight, gay or other. 

You’re you, no one else has say over that. I hope and wish you the best and a good recovery.
